basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old outdoor enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest, with a particular interest in cryptids and the unexplained. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my hobbies. I have a keen interest in skincare, especially Asian beauty products, and I'm a bit of a dog training novice as I recently adopted a rescue pup. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends when I'm not out hiking or exploring new places. Currently single, I enjoy connecting with people who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and working in the field for over five years. My interest in cryptids is purely self-taught, fueled by a childhood fascination with the mysterious and unexplained. I've also gained a lot of practical knowledge about skincare through trial and error, and by interacting with the community on AsianBeautyExchange.
